activities.title: Requirements & specs
consult: design: when the spec changes a screen or a user flow
code: when the spec changes an interface, or it is unclear if it can be built
architecture: when the spec adds a service, a data store or an integration

activities.title: UI design
consult: requirement: when the design changes what a requirement asks
code: when a screen needs new data or a new API
architecture: when the design needs a new component or service

activities.title: Code changes
consult: design: when the change alters a screen
architecture: when the change alters an interface, a dependency or the data model

activities.title: System design & architecture
consult: code: when the design changes code that is already built
requirement: when the design changes the scope or a requirement

activities.title: QA acceptance
consult: code: when a test fails and the cause is not clear

activities.title: Deploy & release
consult: code: when the release holds a migration or a configuration change
qa: when the release holds work qa has not accepted
